cases.name: the shipped definitions: every file of the harness belongs to exactly one pack, no two files land on one path, the switches of every union of packs resolve (--check on the harness tree)

cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
mkstg
put packs/nopack/stray.md
put packs/dev/claude/skills/team-probe/SKILL.md
put packs/dev/claude/rules/twice.md; put claude/rules/twice.md
printf 'name: px\ndescription: p\nspaces: [source]\nswitches:\n  HARNESS_GUARD_PROBE: "0"\n  HARNESS_PROBE_LINES: "100"\n  HARNESS_PROBE: "1"\n' > "$STG/profiles/packs/px.yaml"
printf 'name: py\ndescription: p\nspaces: [source]\nswitches:\n  HARNESS_GUARD_PROBE: "1"\n  HARNESS_PROBE_LINES: "50"\n  HARNESS_PROBE: "0"\n' > "$STG/profiles/packs/py.yaml"
out=$(python3 "$TOOL" --check 2>&1); rc=$?

for want in 'packs/nopack/stray.md belongs to no pack' 'the skill team-probe is in' 'both land on .claude/rules/twice.md' 'HARNESS_PROBE is set to'; do
  printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF "$want" || fail "no [$want] in: $out"
done
rm -rf "$STG/packs/nopack" "$STG/packs/dev/claude/skills/team-probe" "$STG/packs/dev/claude/rules/twice.md"
sed -i '/HARNESS_PROBE: /d' "$STG/profiles/packs/px.yaml" "$STG/profiles/packs/py.yaml"
out=$(python3 "$TOOL" --check 2>&1) || fail "still failing: $out"
r=$F/repo; mkrepo "$r" https://example.invalid/acme/thing.git
out=$(wp "$r" custom:px,py --dry-run) || fail "$out"

harness_keys() { jq -c '[(.env // {} | keys[] | select(startswith("HARNESS_"))), (.skillOverrides // {} | keys[])]' "$1/.claude/settings.local.json"; }
for d in "$w" "$v"; do wp "$d" contrib >/dev/null || fail contrib; [ -f "$d/.claude/skills/contrib-probe/SKILL.md" ] || fail 'contrib not deployed'; done
out=$(wp "$w" user) || fail "$out"
[ ! -e "$w/.claude/skills/contrib-probe" ] && [ "$(harness_keys "$w")" = '[]' ] || fail "user: $(cat "$w/.claude/settings.local.json") $out"
[ "$(jq -c .skillOverrides "$w/.claude/local/profile.owned.json")" = '[]' ] || fail "owned: $(cat "$w/.claude/local/profile.owned.json")"
out=$(wp "$v" user --no-sync) || fail "$out"
[ "$(harness_keys "$v")" = '[]' ] || fail "user --no-sync: $(cat "$v/.claude/settings.local.json")"
sy "$v" >/dev/null && [ ! -e "$v/.claude/skills/contrib-probe" ] || fail 'the next sync did not remove contrib'
printf 'ok'
